customer_accounts.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_customer_accounts

active_customer_sessions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_customer_sessions WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > datetime('now')

password_reset_requests.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_customer_password_resets

active_content_studio_sessions.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_admin_sessions WHERE revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > datetime('now')

runtime_config_keys.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_runtime_config WHERE status = 'active'

business_settings.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_business_settings

customer_accounts_by_day.sql: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_customer_accounts GROUP BY substr(created_at, 1, 10) ORDER BY label DESC LIMIT 14

runtime_config_statuses.sql: SELECT status AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM ap_runtime_config GROUP BY status ORDER BY value DESC, label ASC
